notes.title: The Heartworm 1.1 Update Release Date
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey Everyone![/h2][p]
The 1.1 Update is coming soon with a 15% discount for Heartworm - due out September 29th to coincide with the Steam Autumn sale. The main feature included is a new, optional increased difficulty called “Challenge” mode, with a new costume reward upon completion. This will require much stricter management of resources and more careful decision-making in regard to when to fight or flee. The original, normal difficulty of the game still exists, of course. Other notable features included in this update: [/p][list][*][p]A new camera mod to find: Long Exposure,[/p][/*][*][p]Updates to the final boss fight to make it more challenging and more in line with the initial vision,[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy balance adjustments,[/p][/*][*][p]Steam trading cards,[/p][/*][*][p]Various minor bug fixes and other tweaks,[/p][/*][/list][p]Also, alongside this update will come the much-requested official release of the Heartworm Soundtrack! I’m really excited to finally be able to share that with everyone who has been asking. Finally, I want to again thank everyone who has played, reviewed, and supported the game so far. The reception has been so much better than we could have anticipated, and it’s so awesome to hear how much people have enjoyed our game. I read every review (for better or worse) and appreciate all the feedback. Please, as always, feel free to let me know on Steam or Discord your thoughts, and I can’t wait for you to play the update. 

Thanks,[/p][p]Vincent  [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rwVIo6_uKi8"][/dynamiclink]Check out the soundtrack: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3940700/Heartworm_Original_Video_Game_Soundtrack/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Heartworm Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
[h2]If you had told me years ago,[/h2][p]On the night I sat down in my apartment and created the "[i][b]unityGame1[/b][/i]" project, that this same project would be releasing as a full fledged game - I would have never believed you. 

(Player model and scene are from 2019/2020)[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37290865/cca2ca1f0a76847043f5d46ace211b5e900f87ab.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37290865/d3d39a0b9dcdc46ec1db572dffd6a696a3708015.png"][/img](Sam and the sign from late 2020)[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37290865/3cc82ac33899a4f57058d479ecd0af930f7586ba.png"][/img][/p][h2]Against all odds,[/h2][p]My hobby project to escape from the world in turn became my whole world. I have learned so much, and put everything I could into creating something that myself and my team could be proud of. It has been a long and difficult process, but [b]I am really excited[/b] to share this trailer and [u][b]release date[/b][/u] - and soon to finally be able to share [i][b]Heartworm[/b][/i] in full with you all.  
-Vincent    [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1257030/Heartworm/" style="button"]Click here to wishlist now![/url]
[/p][previewyoutube="t-ckqEK89Ws;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: End of Year Development Update
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!

As we close out the year and move towards the launch of [i][b]Heartworm[/b][/i] next year, we wanted to start showing off more of the game to get everyone excited for Sam's journey through the unknown.
[h1]Demo Update[/h1]

In case you missed it, we refreshed the demo after PAX to include the new boss fight and make the demo experience a better representation of the game.  This latest version features improved textures from the original demo, the ability to enhance your camera with mods, and, most excitingly, a chance to play one of the boss fights from the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37290865/eadd36c5355c53576092f10865558fb7d24e5b33.gif[/img]

Let's get a look at what we're here to talk about.

[h1]Welcome to the Neighborhood[/h1]

If you've played either version of the demo, you're likely very familiar with [b][i]The Neighborhood[/i][/b]. But did you know there are still areas left to explore? 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37290865/14522a281ee85b52b422a01011f2688b16e296aa.png[/img]
When Sam enters Platt St. Deli, the rush of memories is instant. The store is so familiar—the shelves lined with cereal, the scent of fresh-cut meat, the soft chime of the bell above the door. This was where her Grandfather once worked, and Sam has so many fond memories of this place. But being back here now, she can't seem to find those fond memories; instead, she only feels the sadness as she's reminded yet again of what he's gone.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37290865/efb34b10626a298e07aab96d7ab7f653fea45c17.png[/img]

[h1]Static Wraith[/h1]
The Static Wraiths shudder and warp as they trudge, their shifting masses of discordant distortion ceaselessly pulsing to an unnatural rhythm. They wander, ever emitting their mournful hum, the fading echoes of memories slipping away. Each one, visitor lost to this place—every flicker and buzz an an echoing reminder of loss- of refusal to let go.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37290865/fe841d0ff2ad1dc9620ff01fb6d4c72006249185.gif[/img]


The Static Wraith attacks by releasing a flow of static. As the static flows over Sam, it slows their movement. The longer Sam is caught in the static, the more sluggish she becomes. The Wraith uses this moment to close the gap, forcing Sam to overcome the static and fight back before it can strike.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37290865/eec2a47617391869817996192f08cbfcbe01be58.gif[/img]

notes.title: Post-PAX Development Update!
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!

It's been a while since we've updated everyone on the progress that's been made in [i][b]Heartworm[/b][/i], so we wanted to keep you all in the loop!

[h1]PAX West Demo[/h1]

In case you missed it, we showcased a fresh, updated demo at PAX! This new version featured improved textures from the original demo, the ability to enhance the camera with mods, and, most excitingly, a thrilling boss fight from the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37290865/eadd36c5355c53576092f10865558fb7d24e5b33.gif[/img]

[h1]Check out the Wilderness[/h1]

In addition to showcasing the demo, we also wanted to give you a glimpse of some new environments you'll be able to explore in the game beyond [b][i]The Neighborhood[/i][/b]!

During Sam's journey, they will find themselves lost in the dense [i][b]Wilderness[/b][/i]. What truths wait down the trail? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37290865/d264735641168779e28eeaa45ff1757f751cba77.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37290865/b30a30231bb65bf2f62058a636ddbd2ba6f2fb8b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37290865/d794f42211daeaf7d42d828afc689ffa6a1a2bf3.jpg[/img]

As a comparison, here's a screenshot showing the pixelated filter on/off

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37290865/ae1218e28d38a70a63324792ccbc2aeeb439ae5f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37290865/7555f9672499028cae664737db5bc737c5eab451.jpg[/img]

"I was so happy to be able to show off the new demo at PAX West and even more so to watch people enjoy it. Admittedly I am always pretty nervous showing off the game, but that melted away so quickly as I met and talked to everyone who is excited about [i][b]Heartworm[/b][/i]. A lot of you had positive things to say and great feedback - it's really inspiring to hear how excited people are for this game and how passionate they are about the genre. Can't wait to show you more." - Vincent.
